note: The black hole entry. Picture is cut to this timing: each phrase carries the action it belongs to, and a shot ends only after its last phrase. Times are filled by tools/film/edl.py from the final voice takes.

shots.action: The liner, tiny, against the disk. No voices. Only the ship's own hum dropping away.
Deck, silent. A stylus drifts up off the console. Zenvik watches it. Nobody else has noticed.
Draxum turns from the window. He has seen the course screen.

phrases: Why is your login on the course change?

shots.action: Close on Zenvik. The eyes go to the screen, then to everyone looking at him.
The deck tilts a degree. Every loose object slides at once. The argument stops mid breath.
Outside: the hull flexes, plates lifting along the spine. The ship is longer than it was.
Bolzar, both hands on a bulkhead, listening to it with his whole body.

lines.direction: gentle, to the wall, as if to an animal

shots.action: The rib beside his hand buckles. He looks at it. Then at nobody.
Nuvexa, phone up out of pure habit, realises what she is filming and lowers it.

lines.direction: tiny joke, dies in the air
phrases: this is not for the story.

shots.action: The window cracks across. Silence for a beat. Everyone sees it.
It goes. The six are thrown, tumbling, reaching for anything.
Outside. The ring of six, hand to hand, turning above the hole. The grip is going.

lines.direction: terror turning into a joke she can't finish
